question: A square with side length 4 is placed in a horizontal plane, with one side parallel to the horizontal axis. What is the length of this side in the pictorial drawing?
solution:
Under the recorded unscaled school oblique-dimetric convention, this side is parallel to the original horizontal axis, so its drawn length remains \(4\).

The displayed question does not specify this convention or scale. A half-size copy of that drawing would give length \(2\), so the answer \(4\) depends on the recorded convention.
